messages:
Rae: Starting thread for Skylark POC. Customer wants clear answers for: SCIM delta window, burst/rate limits, SAML attribute mapping, RBAC provisioning flow, domain ownership proof, and whether Hosted vs Dedicated changes fallback auth behavior. Need a concise set of statements for the security questionnaire + a POC sizing note. @Jon @Marta can you jump in?

Jon: SCIM defaults: delta_window = 900s (15m). For Dedicated we can go to 300s; for short-term POC we can temporarily set 60s but we log increased resource usage. Default rate_limit = 300 req/min/tenant; POC temporary bump to 700 req/min is doable for up to 14 days. Recommend using the batch endpoint for initial imports.

Marta: RBAC/SAML: primary pattern is to read roles from SAML attribute `roles` (comma-separated) and map to internal roles via an explicit mapping table maintained in the console. SCIM groups can also map to roles. We never auto-grant org_admin without an explicit mapping. Delegated-admin mode is opt-in and produces extra audit events. Example mapping we give customers: `app_admin -> platform_admin`, `eng_read -> viewer`.

Ken: Domain ownership: we support DNS TXT verification (recommended for email subdomains), HTTP file challenge, and signed SAML metadata ownership. For quick POC use DNS TXT.

Rae: Security also asked: if IdP is unavailable, can users still log in? Need a one-line formal answer.

Marta: One-line: "Optional email magic-link fallback is supported when enabled; for Dedicated deployments, fallback may be blocked by customer network or outbound email policy and requires explicit enablement."

Jon: Hosted vs Dedicated differences (brief): both support SAML/OIDC + SCIM. Dedicated adds private KMS, VPC egress controls, and tunable SCIM limits. Fallback behavior is feature-parity but operationally subject to customer network/KMS policies on Dedicated.

Rae: POC sizing info needed by SE/sales: expected total users, expected daily delta ops, number of groups, and peak SCIM QPS. Customer initial ask: ~12k users, ~2.5k daily delta, ~80 groups.

sec-bot: Reminder: attach completed security questionnaire PDF and sample SCIM config before sending to customer.

Jon: Quick sample (for docs): `PATCH /scim/v2/Users` body: `[ { \"op\": \"replace\", \"path\": \"emails[0].value\", \"value\": \"user@skylark.co\" } ]`. SCIM config snippet: `scim.delta_window_seconds=900; scim.rate_limit_per_min=300; scim.batch_enabled=true`.

Rae: Action items: @Jon produce the SCIM POC config + temporary SLA note; @Marta draft the RBAC mapping example and security QA one-liner; @Ken confirm domain verification steps in the questionnaire. I'll collect the sizing sheet and attach. Thanks all :thumbsup:"
